title: Slurm
description: Documented public HPC scheduler (SchedMD (open source)) for the Supercomputer Workload Planner capability area.
body:
Slurm is a documented HPC scheduler from SchedMD (open source). The dominant open-source workload manager on TOP500 supercomputers, scheduling millions of parallel jobs.

How it works: It works by sorting jobs largest-first and placing each on the node pool, tracking makespan and utilization.

Documented uses of this capability area include supercomputer job scheduling, cryptographic migration planning, chaos-engineering programs, and disaster-recovery verification.
